dialect: Standard Japanese (hyōjungo, Tokyo-based), written in kanji + kana

profile.noun_citation: dictionary form; counters noted in discussion
profile.pronunciation_convention: IPA, broad transcription, Tokyo standard; pitch accent not marked; spoken = Hepburn
profile.grammar_notes: Zero copula in plain speech (だ/です as copula); いる/ある for existence by animacy; politeness is marked grammatically (plain vs です/ます, plus keigo: sonkeigo/kenjōgo); particles は/が/を/に/で are a closed core set; aspect via 〜ている; heavy use of sentence-final particles (よ/ね/よね) and explanatory の/んだ; conditionals と/ば/たら/なら form a closed set; giving/receiving verbs あげる/くれる/もらう form a closed set; counters. At B2 the building blocks are assumed; the job is traps, register and constructions that still block fluent understanding.
